statement: A projection, not a published estimate. QRE v3's model of magic state cultivation (GSJ24Factory) replaces the round-based factory the published estimates use, with the same programs, trace transform, error budget and selection rule, on every gate-based qubit profile. The published estimates are each problem's circuits/estimate.json, and this scenario does not change them.
ties: Where several configurations tie on physical qubits and runtime, which one the estimator reports can change between runs, so a combination's recorded error and magic-state error rates can change on regeneration. Its physical qubits and runtime cannot.

cultivationModel.title: Magic state cultivation: growing T states as cheap as CNOT gates

experiment.title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
experiment.quote: Cultivation reduces the error by a factor of 40, with a state fidelity of 0.9999(1) (retaining 8% of attempts).
